roadmap_item.title: Establish Cassor recovery and collaboration semantics
roadmap_item.description: Make SQLite state portable through deterministic versioned export/import with explicit conflict behavior and checkout ownership rules.
roadmap_item.rationale: The ignored local database needs a safe backup and transfer path before more stateful projections are added.

goal: Users can back up and restore complete supported Cassor logical state with deterministic exports and transactional failure behavior.

included: Versioned deterministic JSON export of supported logical tables
Transactional import preserving IDs, relationships, approvals, criteria, evidence, events, and reports
Format validation, corrupt input rejection, and existing-state conflict rejection
Recovery procedure and branch/worktree ownership documentation
excluded: Automatic sharing of state between worktrees
Generated roadmap files as an authoritative import source

decisions: SQLite in each checkout's .cassor directory is authoritative; Git branches and worktrees do not automatically share state.
Import targets an initialized empty database and rejects logical conflicts rather than guessing merges.
Export format version 1 uses stable table order and primary-key order with no runtime timestamps added during export.
acceptance_criteria: Export/import into a fresh database preserves supported logical state and relationships.
Equivalent state produces byte-identical deterministic exports.
Invalid, incompatible, or conflicting imports fail without partially modifying the destination.
Users have documented recovery and explicit branch/worktree behavior.
constraints: Retain SQLite as the live authority.
Never persist transcripts or hidden reasoning in the export.
Preserve approval history, verification history, blocking history, and stable identifiers.

tasks.title: Implement deterministic logical state export
tasks.description: Serialize supported Cassor tables in stable order with an explicit format version and no generated values.

tasks.title: Implement transactional validated import
tasks.description: Validate format, references, and empty-destination conflicts before atomically restoring all supported records.

tasks.title: Add recovery CLI and document checkout ownership
tasks.description: Expose export/import commands and document backup, recovery, generated-roadmap boundaries, and branch/worktree semantics.

risks: Future schema changes can make an export incompatible; the version must fail clearly until a compatible importer exists.
Importing into a non-empty state may need merge semantics later; rejecting conflicts keeps restoration predictable for version 1.
